$comment: The FONT KIT plan (the owner, 2026-10-16; LAYOUT.md §9): Poppins carried INSIDE every tool, because staging and some devices have no Poppins. `node cli.mjs fontkit` subsets each face with fontTools to these ranges (Latin, the rupee and the maths signs, Devanagari for Hindi; Gujarati stays on the device's font) as woff2 and writes runtime/fontkit.tsx (generated, never read). The family name is private, so it never clashes with a page's own Poppins.
